create_a2a_client: create an A2AClient instance with a base URL, timeout, and optional extra headers for A2A agent communication
get_agent_card: get the agent card from the A2A server to retrieve agent capabilities and metadata
send_message: send a SendMessageRequest to the A2A agent and receive a LiteLLMSendMessageResponse
send_message_streaming: send a SendStreamingMessageRequest to the A2A agent and stream SendStreamingMessageResponse chunks
test_a2a_client: test the A2AClient class by initializing it and verifying send_message and get_agent_card methods
